# BEIR custom metrics, unchanged source

Source: https://github.com/beir-cellar/beir/blob/ef83d29307061c65d04b035b4f4e7c18bd8374af/beir/retrieval/custom_metrics.py

Commit ef83d29307061c65d04b035b4f4e7c18bd8374af; Git blob 097828c23f4f36a1e20a1c79b7e61188085082d6. Apache-2.0; complete license is retained alongside the source. No modifications. Runtime loads only this audited standard-library module and calls mrr. No BEIR package, pytrec_eval, downloads, model runners or source-install scripts are executed. This component is upstream work, not a project-original metric implementation.
